_doc: Fingerprint of the Postiz text converter that tests/fixtures/postiz_pipeline.json was generated from. claimgate_sync.py compares the live postiz container against it every run and records drift in claimgate.meta('converter_drift'); claimgate-watch reports it. On drift: regenerate the fixture (deploy/claimgate/README.md 'Regenerating the pipeline fixture'), run the tests, and update this file in the same PR.
